description: Analytics implementation framework for WordPress sites: intake assessment, tracking plan development, GA4/GTM implementation, and validation

required.name: site_url
required.description: URL of the target WordPress site

required.name: site_type
required.description: Type of site (e.g., ecommerce, blog, SaaS)

required.name: tracking_goals
required.description: Business tracking objectives and KPIs to measure

optional.name: ga4_measurement_id
optional.description: Existing GA4 measurement ID if already set up

optional.name: gtm_container_id
optional.description: Existing GTM container ID if already set up

optional.name: existing_tracking_tools
optional.description: Currently installed tracking tools and their state

optional.name: key_conversions
optional.description: Primary conversion events to track (form submissions, purchases, etc.)

optional.name: ecommerce_platform
optional.description: Ecommerce platform if applicable (WooCommerce, Shopify, etc.)

optional.name: consent_management_platform
optional.description: CMP in use for cookie/tracking consent

optional.name: utm_conventions
optional.description: UTM parameter naming conventions for campaign tracking

directories.description: All analytics tracking deliverables and reports
